newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela Senate passes Privatisation Reform Law.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela Senate passes Privatisation Reform Law.

text.p: The Venezuelan Senate passed Wednesday the Privatisation Law Reform Bill, which opens the way for the government's offering of its 40 percent share in telephone company CANTV, legislators said.
The bill now goes to the executive for signing.
Senator Jose Angel Oropeza said the bill rapidly passed muster after the Senate agreed to Congress's wording of crucial Article 22.
The Article allows small Venezuelan investors to buy shares on the Caracas bolsa, so strengthening the government's push to encourage popular shareholding as part of its privatisation program.
Venezuelan Investment Fund President Alberto Poletto is due to unveil details of government plans to encourage popular participation in the CANTV sale later this week.
